description:
Intent i023 (callee-pull-caller-stale, snapshot s02) complete. Artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C6/agent-state/findings/i023.json with 2 findings, 3 candidates, snapshots_checked=["s02"].

FINDING 1 (medium): s02:drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1903-1966 — interprocedural callee->caller stale-pointer variant of the seed's pep_get_sb() UAF. Caller mwl8k_txq_xmit() captures mgmt = (struct ieee80211_mgmt *)skb->data at line 1903 (raw pointer into skb->head); lines 1918-1921 pass the skb to callees mwl8k_encapsulate_tx_frame(priv, skb) (which funnels into mwl8k_add_dma_header at :926) or mwl8k_add_dma_header(priv, skb, 0, 0). The callee mwl8k_add_dma_header() executes pskb_expand_head(skb, REDUCED_TX_HEADROOM, 0, GFP_ATOMIC) at line 853 when priv->ap_fw && hdrlen < sizeof(struct ieee80211_cts) + REDUCED_TX_HEADROOM, freeing and replacing the old head, so every pre-call head pointer must be reloaded. The caller refetches only wh (line 1923) and never mgmt; stale mgmt->u.action.category, mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code and .capab are dereferenced at lines 1963-1966, driving tid extraction and mwl8k_tid_queue_mapping() TX queue selection — kernel/hardware state transition through possibly-freed slab memory, same class as the seed's ph->sb_type read after pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len).

FINDING 2 (medium): s02:drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:843-874 — callee-internal twin: wh = (struct ieee80211_hdr *)skb->data captured at 843, hdrlen = ieee80211_hdrlen(wh->frame_control) at 845, pskb_expand_head at 853 frees the old head, then stale wh is read at 867 (ieee80211_is_data_qos(wh->frame_control)) and used as the memmove(&tr->wh, wh, hdrlen) source at 871-872 with hdrlen derived from the same possibly-freed frame_control byte. This site is not on i023's skip list (the s02 tx-cow artifact f005 pattern-screened but did not report mwl8k), and the identical shape was independently reported as a bug for the s04 (facts f014/f024) and s01 (f022/f025) twins, confirming the defect class in this driver family.

Safe: mwl8k_encapsulate_tx_frame (line 893) reads wh only before its callee call — no post-return dereference.

Bounded limitations: the full tree-wide callee->caller enumeration over s02 net/ and drivers/ was not executed before the finalize directive; only the mwl8k chain was deep-read with exact source lines. Unexamined surfaces: ip_mc_check_igmp/ipv6_mc_check_mld validator callers, l2tp session->recv_skb callbacks, strparser, and driver RX helper pairs. All findings are static hypotheses: no KASAN/runtime reproducer; triggering requires the pskb_expand_head branch (AP firmware, short 802.11 header) to actually free the old head, and attacker control over the mac80211 TX skb bytes is indirect compared to the seed's remote RX packet. No network/Git access to check upstream fix status.
